label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_01
text: Do you want to face the Sub-zero Shredder\nhimself, Gym Leader Grusha?

label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_02
text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.

label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_03
text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.

label: gym_koori_040_poke_01
text: Bwaaah!

label: gym_koori_040_koori_00
text: There you are![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_01
text: Brrrrrr... I’m freezing...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_02
text: ...I take it you’re a challenger?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_03
text: My name’s Grusha. I’m a snowboarder. Used to\nbe pro, actually.\c\nNow I’m a Gym Leader.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_04
text: I saw you on the slopes. Your skills... Yeah, they\nwere pretty cool.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_05
text: But don’t let that go to your head.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_06
text: Winter mountains are dangerous. They can throw\nyour life right off course, easy as that.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_07
text: Same thing with Pokémon battles, really...\nIt’s always the most dangerous when you’re\r\njust starting to get the hang of things.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_08
text: Today’s not a great day to face me, you know...\nYou’re better off giving up.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_09
text: You sure you want to battle me?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_select_01
text: You bet!

label: gym_koori_040_select_02
text: Uh, I’m not sure now...

label: gym_koori_040_koori_10
text: Still tryin’ to act cool, huh? That’s too bad.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_11
text: Nice. Backing off takes its own kind of courage.\nBut I know your type. You always choose to push\r\nforward in the end.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_12
text: Well, this is my job now...so don’t take what\nI’m about to do personally.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_13
text: Get ready to feel the icy bite of reality.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_14
text: That burning passion you have... You strive for\nthe future, no matter what challenges you face.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_15
text: Just like how I used to be...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_16
text: Oh, never mind. I should give you your\nGym Badge.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_17
text: Huh? You want a photo together to\ncommemorate your win...?[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_18
text: C-come on, that’s...that’s so uncool.\nI don’t usually do that sort of thing, but...\r\nOK, fine. Special occasion.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_badge
text: With [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, you should be able to catch\nPokémon of up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)] more easily.\c\nThey’ll actually listen to you too, which is nice.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_badge_all
text: With 8 Gym Badges, you should be able to catch\nPokémon of any level. They’ll also listen to every\r\nword you say, whether it’s cool or not.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_waza
text: Oh, and before I forget—you should take\nthis, too.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_19
text: Should be a lot more useful than some silly\nphoto of you and me...[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_koori_20
text: Feel free to stop by again... If you don’t mind the\ncold, that is.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

label: gym_koori_040_receptionist_04
text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nGlaseado Gym!
